description: This PHP class 'FormatWithEmployeeName' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format values by retrieving an employee's full name using their employee number. It is part of the OrangeHRM system's maintenance access strategy for formatting feature values with employee names.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeName
classes.description: Implements value formatting by fetching an employee's full name based on employee number.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee given their employee number, using the employee service.
